title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for Personal Finance and Budgeting Apps in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to a money app: a real data model for transactions and budgets, private-by-default accounts, outside data connections, reports, alerts, and AI insights.
body_markdown: Blink, at 73 out of 80, because it builds transactions and budgets on a database with row-level security, sends budget alerts by push, and runs AI categorization inside the app. FlutterFlow is second at 52.
